title: Sailor Almost Killed in Motorcycle Crash
description: Petty Officer Van Gutten learned the hard way that it takes only a second and one bad decision for your life to change.  He survived the mishap, but his life will never be the same.  Van Gutten and his family talk about the mishap and his recovery.
keywords: crash, accident, PSA, Naval Safety Center, mishap, Van Gutten, navy, motorcycle, Marine Corps, Norfolk
unit_name: Defense Safety Oversight Council, Private Motor Vehicle Task Force
